svg.title: A framework change without its proof card never reaches the main branch — GitLab stops a framework change that ships with no proof card, and lets it through once the card is added
svg.text: A framework change without its proof card never reaches
Scenario: GitLab stops a framework change that ships with no proof card, and lets it through once the card is

g.text: Given a merge request changes a framework file and brings no proof
card, GitLab refuses to merge it
This merge request changes one framework file and brings no proof card with it. GitLab will
not let it in: the merge box reads "Merge blocked: 1 check failed", and the reason
underneath is "Pipeline must succeed." Nothing here depends on a reviewer noticing the
omission, the project refuses the change on its own.
When the author opens the failed job, it names the file left without
A red job is useless if it does not say why, so the author opens it. The storyboard-coverage
job spells out its verdict: "Product changed with NO storyboard card changed or added", then
names the file it caught. It also gives the two ways forward: add a card under
project/tests/e2e/features/, or, when a change genuinely has nothing to show, write a
"Storyboard-exempt:" line in the commit message so the reviewer reads the reason.
Then the author adds the missing proof card and the same job turns
The author pushes the missing proof card to the same merge request, changing nothing else.
The very same storyboard-coverage job now reads Passed, with the opposite verdict: "Product
changed and a storyboard was changed/added", followed by the card that satisfied it. The
change can go in, and it goes in with its picture.
